name: What is the difference between hiring a general finish contractor and a standalone tile layer?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between hiring a general finish contractor and a standalone tile layer?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full-scope remodeling contractor handles structural framing, drywall repairs, plumbing coordination, and tile setting under a single point of contact. Bathroom tiling rarely happens in isolation; replacing a shower or tub surround often requires relocating supply lines, installing new valves, sistering weak joists, or patching adjacent drywall. An independent tile-only installer may require you to hire separate trades to fix rotted studs or move plumbing pipes before they can start. HH Remodeling manages both the underlying carpentry, moisture barriers, and final finish tile work directly, streamlining the entire bathroom project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A finish contractor handles underlying carpentry, drywall repairs, and plumbing coordination alongside tile work, avoiding the need to hire multiple separate trades.
